title: [E-Document Core] Grant Execute on the status factbox, PDF preview and Navigate handler
summary: The E-Document Core permission set now grants Execute permission on the status factbox page, picture preview page, and navigate handler codeunit to prevent permission errors when users access E-Document components on standard pages.
key_points: Adds Execute on page 6187 E-Doc. Status FactBox, page 6111 Inbound E-Doc. Picture and codeunit 6247 E-Doc. Navigate Handler to permission set E-Doc. Core - Objects
Fixes a permission error when opening a Sales Order for users whose custom sets have no page wildcard
Page 6187 is a part on 25 standard pages, page 6111 is a part on purchase invoice and draft pages, and codeunit 6247 subscribes to Navigate
E-Doc. Core - Read, User, Admin, Edit and Basic inherit the new grants
A test checks that the expanded Read set grants Execute on these objects
